Class SourceToken

java.lang.Object
net.emustudio.emulib.plugins.compiler.SourceToken
All Implemented Interfaces:
Token
public final class SourceToken extends Object implements Token
Immutable lexical token with optional compiler-provided semantic editing metadata.
